# GTS segment of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:gtsSegmentOf`](gmeow-gtsSegmentOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/gtsSegmentOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/gts`](../../slices/gts.md)
- **Box roles:** [ConfigBox role](../boxes/boxconfigbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The GTS document a segment is part of. Functional: a segment instance belongs to one document (the same bytes appearing in another file are a different segment instance of the same content). A subproperty of [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md), so disclosure coarsening walks it by default.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) -> [`gmeow:GTSDocument`](../classes/gmeow-GTSDocument.md); functional
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:gtsSegmentOf`](gmeow-gtsSegmentOf.md) from [`gmeow:GTSSegment`](../classes/gmeow-GTSSegment.md) to [`gmeow:GTSDocument`](../classes/gmeow-GTSDocument.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to assert which document a segment belongs to — the segment-rooted direction of the document/segment parthood, the natural one to state when minting a segment.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reusing one segment instance across documents (it is functional — the same bytes elsewhere are a distinct instance) and avoid asserting the document-rooted direction here (use [`gmeow:gtsSegment`](gmeow-gtsSegment.md) for that).

### How to use

- Point the segment at its single document; the inverse [`gmeow:gtsSegment`](gmeow-gtsSegment.md) and the generic [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md) follow automatically, so generic part/whole consumers and disclosure coarsening walk it without extra assertion.
